title: Point to a place only when known
statement: Let model-written feedback name a place in the text, such as its first line, only when the model was given each excerpt's position; otherwise block such claims in code.
example: A feedback-only safeguard passed 52/52 route checks, against 9 expected failures on the old route.
detail: On a third miss, a generated hint told a child to look at the very first line of the story for an offer that comes later (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, line 1328). The feedback writer had been given grounding excerpts with no story positions, and the first excerpt happened to hold the offer. The repair was a deterministic, feedback-only locator safeguard, and an independent review verified it on 52/52 route checks against 9 expected failures on the old route, with all 134 original assertions unchanged (line 1339).
against: The cause is a co-occurrence, not a proven mechanism: "The first excerpt happens to contain the offer; that correlation does not establish model-internal causation." (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, line 1328). The safeguard was proven only under controlled responses: "Finite detector protection is proven under controlled route responses; no forced native bad phrase or universal language claim." (line 1339).
